name: tuple-threshold255
query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 255
source: Fresh pinned-main HTTP capture after fixed five-query history
